Phase-1 rule: No relation concept links a player to a count of leading in scoring; the query asks for an attribute/statistic of the player, so match the concept of the KNOWN entity, which is player_performance (or player_stats). Source selection: KG is RULED-OUT because its elements (player_id, name, etc.) do not include any scoring or game-level statistics. Table is LIKELY because player_performance and player_stats tables contain per-game or per-season scoring data, and monthly game logs (e.g., teamgame) could provide February game details. Primary source is table as it directly covers statistical performance; fallback is kg as it may provide player identification.
